messages:
Maya: BDO audit team requested consolidated evidence for recent KMS rotations + RBAC change log for SOC 2 control mapping. They want machine-readable artifacts and a short narrative linking rotations to any mitigations. Due COB tomorrow.
Diego: We can provide CloudTrail rotate/change events, our KMS policy diffs (from git), and the RBAC audit (IAM & k8s rolebinding diffs). Question: do they need the full git history or only the commit that applied the change?
Auditor_BDO: We need the commit(s) that resulted in production key policy changes, plus the approval trail (who signed off). Also a mapping showing which principals had decrypt/GenerateDataKey permissions before and after each change. A short remediation timeline if any CVE triggered a rotation.
Maya: Plan: 1) export CloudTrail events for CreateKey/RotateKey/DisableKey/UpdateKeyDescription for last 120 days. 2) git diff of infra/kms-policies between tags prod@2026-01-01 and prod@2026-03-01. 3) IAM+IRSA mapping CSV for principals with kms:*Decrypt* actions. 4) produce manifest.csv + bundle tar.gz + sha256.
Diego: Sample CLI for git diff:
```
git --no-pager log --pretty=format:'%H %an %ad %s' --since="2026-01-01" --until="2026-03-31" -- infra/kms-policies/ > kms-policy-commits.log
git diff prod@2026-01-15 prod@2026-02-20 -- infra/kms-policies/ > kms-policy-diff.patch
```
Diego: For IAM scan I run a two-step: list role ARNs, then fetch attached inline+managed policy documents and grep for kms:Decrypt or "kms:*". I store output as roles_kms_rights.json.
Maya: Don't include secret key material; redact principal emails. Auditor asked for pseudonymous IDs mapping to internal employee IDs via separate secure channel.
Auditor_BDO: Yes, provide pseudonymous identifiers in artifacts and send mapping via secure SFTP. Also include any incident ticket that precipitated an emergency rotation.
Diego: Note: On 2026-03-10 we rotated key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999888777:key/rot-44 following vulnerability triage CVE-2026-9988 (see TICKET-991). That rotation included a CreateGrant step to permit read-only access to backup-service for 24h. Include logs showing grant creation and subsequent deletion.
Maya: evidence_bot, kick off evidence bundle with tags: kms, rbac, soc2, iso. Include redaction_map and SOP pointer.
evidence_bot: bundle-job-1720501234 queued. Expected completion ~6m. :rocket: 
Diego: Manifest CSV format we'll use: artifact_type,source,created_at,evidence_file,sha256,redacted
Sample row:
``nartifact_type,source,created_at,evidence_file,sha256,redacted
cloudtrail,aws-cloudtrail,2026-03-10T09:41:12Z,cloudtrail_rotate_20260310.json,9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08,true
```
Maya: Also attach a short narrative (500-800 chars) per rotation: what triggered it, approver, ticket link, post-rotation verification steps (decrypt smoke tests).
Auditor_BDO: Screenshots are ok but we prefer logs. Please include smoke test logs showing successful decrypts after rotation. Also annotate any grant lifetimes.
Diego: Evidence bundle ready: https://s3.internal.company/evidence/1720501234_bundle.tar.gz :lock: sha256: a3c9bd3f4b7e1e0c6f4a9a0d7b1f2e45f4b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0
Maya: Uploaded manifest.csv, redaction_map.csv, kms-policy-diff.patch, roles_kms_rights.json, and smoke-tests-20260310.log.
Auditor_BDO: Received. We'll validate and may request clarifying mapping for one serviceaccount showing temporary grant usage.
Diego: I'll be available 10:30-12:00 PST to walk through the IRSA mapping if needed.
Maya: Thanks — sending the cover response now with links and the secure SFTP instructions for identity mapping. :white_check_mark:
